question: What measure is prescribed for the middle of the palm or sole?
premises: The middle of the palm is specified as a sixth part.
This measure is joined with two barleycorn units.
The optative expresses a prescriptive rule.
inference: The middle of the palm or sole should measure one sixth part plus two barleycorns.
plain_english: The middle of the palm or sole should be one sixth part together with two barleycorns.
